method_limits: a call site cannot say which arm of the builder it will hit, so every arm of a builder inherits that builder's production sites -- this is exposure per builder, not observed execution

a call is attributed to a builder only when the name resolves through the same module-import rules E515 uses (a bare imported name, a module alias, or the defining module); a dynamically dispatched call is not seen
guards are counted the way E515 counts them: an if-statement between the call and the first read of the bound name that ends the enclosing function on one arm

an arm is 'testable' only when the published E518 distinguishability is is-None, truthiness, type or same-arity unpack; sentinel arms whose shape equals the read arm's shape are untestable by construction
nothing is executed and no source is rewritten
